title: Good base but missing potential
body: The NFC capability is great as well as many customizable features like weekly habits.  However, the progress reporting is lacking which takes away from clarity of improvement and motivation to continue.  For example, in the previous week’s report, there is no reference to total successes, fails and skips.  You have to add them up yourself.  It gives you a total successes percentage but not the raw numbers that percentage is calculated with.  I am available if a developer would like to know more.  I have experience with other habit tracking apps that have features I think are worth contemplating.

title: Not adapted for apple watch
body:
In the apple whatch when i selected to show the habits by current time of day or a specific area created in the widgets, the moment i tap to get in the app it doesnt show me that specific area, it takes me the general screen where there is all the divisions for the habits. Why do you have the option to select which area you want to pick if it actually does nothing. Also i paid for premium to be able to use different icons, why is not shown in apple watch? Also tasks inside an habit are not shown in apple watch, nether notes. People could simply use the microphone to write there too but its not enabled.

Also is weird that in apple watch it gives you more options for quick log in a habit, it should just log the amount you settled when created the habit to marc as done. It doesn’t make any sense that exist on apple Watch when its not even needed. Its not like that on the iphone or ipad experience, you just tap to say you are done with it.

Delete task is imposible, also it would be nice to keep record of the tasks you already done without getting in the way in the work area, there is plenty room down. There, you could revisit the achievements you’ve made in that habit. The system is not user friendly, its tricky to make corrections

This should help to create habits effortlessly, not make the process of creating a habit a complicated thing. Motivation is affected alomg the way in relation to our progress toward our goals

Please make it work, it disrupt my experience, but if you make the changes it could be the dream app for every person who has the intention of progress but not the HABIT to make things happen.
